subject: ENGLISH
title: Meet the Characters · M01 D02
objective: Identify story characters and infer feelings from actions.
introduction: A character is a person or animal in a story. Feelings should be supported by words or actions. Explore examples, sort cards, practice, and answer five questions.

vocabulary.definition: A tale with characters and events.
A person or animal in a story.
A living thing that can move and needs food.
